main.description: A member of the canvas's context paints one cell, and then waits out the cooldown. The cell becomes theirs: a repaint takes over the colour, the painter and the time. The cooldown is the server's, so it holds whatever a client does.

colour.description: An index into the client's palette, which only ever grows at the end.

next_paint_at.description: Unix milliseconds, on the server's clock.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such canvas, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a member of the canvas's context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A cell off the board, or no such colour.

errors.name: TooSoon
errors.description: The cooldown has not run out (HTTP 429). The body carries `retry_after_ms`.

errors.name: CanvasClosed
errors.description: The canvas takes no more paint (HTTP 409).
